seo.description: Snibe biochemistry test menu: 114 tests in 13 groups, searchable by assay name. Explore assays and biochemistry and electrolytes in the LabWell catalog.

C1_hero.lead: The Snibe biochemistry test menu is the manufacturer’s list of biochemistry assays, organized by group. According to Snibe’s current list, the menu covers 114 tests in 13 groups, including cardiac markers, liver and kidney function, lipids and ion-selective electrodes; assay names are reproduced verbatim from the manufacturer.
